originalTitle: Identifying Panel Conditioning with Refreshment Samples: Sharp Bounds and Design Assumptions
originalSummary: Refreshment samples are the standard remedy for panel attrition, and the identification results behind them maintain that participation does not change measurement. We characterize what a refreshment sample identifies about panel conditioning, modelled as a deterministic monotone map at reinterview, when attrition is unrestricted. A candidate map is consistent with the data if and only if the retention-scaled distribution of the stayers' implied latent outcomes is setwise dominated by the refreshment distribution; every such map is rationalized by an explicit attrition process. titleZh: 用补充样本识别重复调查效应：紧界限与设计假设
summaryZh: 补充样本通常用于应对面板调查中的样本流失，但相关识别结果通常假设：参与调查本身不会改变测量结果。本文研究在不限制样本流失机制的情况下，补充样本能够识别哪些重复调查效应，并将这一效应建模为再次访问时的确定性单调映射。候选映射与数据一致的充要条件是：留存者隐含潜在结果的分布，经留存率缩放后，在各可测集合上都不超过补充样本的分布；每个满足条件的映射都可由一个明确的样本流失过程实现。原订阅摘要后续内容已截断。
